title: A fire in an Swiss ski resort bar has left about 40 people dead
summary: A New Year's party at a Swiss Alpine bar turned into a tragedy after about 40 people died in a fire and another roughly 115 were injured, many in their teens to mid-20s.
contentText:
A New Year's party at a Swiss Alpine bar turned into a tragedy after about 40 people died in a fire and another roughly 115 were injured, many in their teens to mid-20s.

(Image credit: Alessandro della Valle/AP)
